newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold volume sinks on lack of demand.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold volume sinks on lack of demand.

text.p: Volume on the Istanbul gold exchange dropped to 417 kilos on Friday from Thursday's 1,335 kilos due to a lack of demand from the free market and the absence of banks engaging in arbitrage deals, dealers said.
Gold rose to 1,482,000 lira per gram from Thursday's 1,472,000 lira close on firmer world levels and a weak Turkish lira. There were no dollar deals. Thursday's dollar closing was $349.00 an ounce.
The Turkish currency eased to 131,350 against the dollar from Thursday's 131,040 close.
Of the day's volume, 402 kilos of gold was traded in the morning session.
